classification: isolated offline evidence-schema experiment; no runtime change
hypothesis: Individually validated source-bound numeric-cell units can survive unrelated row ambiguity and whole-table byte rejection while preserving their literal dependencies.

comparison.FCT12: one new numeric-cell admission and budgeting variant

fixed: original A12 Dense/BM25 candidates, scores and RRF order
all original document fields, literal text, source IDs and order
UTF-8 compact canonical JSON cap 65536 bytes
same original source XML and saved table payloads
first delivered owner for each physical table; no payload union from duplicate owners
unit_source: Only existing table_object.rows[].cells[]; original XML verifies saved literals and locators but cannot fill missing data. No text-row fallback or inferred number extraction.
global_gates: strict original grid/span geometry and declared saved shape
entire saved header prefix exactly equals raw leading grid rows, retaining old conservative row-offset gate
local_gates: precheck duplicate rows/columns before admitting any dependent unit
ambiguous or invalid saved row-axis mapping rejects all units in that row
changed value or cell-header stack rejects that cell only when other addresses remain reliable
shared physical axis dependencies retain their validated span ownership
invalid literal context excluded independently and its absent semantics not filled
literal_axes: Every saved row-axis label must map uniquely in order to distinct physical cells; all value-column and row-axis-column prefix cells are included so e.g. a date retains its own column role. Source-declared THEAD/TH headers remain distinct from inferred prefix data rows.
semantic_boundary: Physical source binding is not proof of requested entity, reporting period, consolidation or unit semantics. Scalar metadata, company/year hints and gold answers cannot repair absent axes.

wire.frame: verified document hash, table locator, literal located contexts, actual declared header rows, explicit axis limitation and source ID
wire.cells: deduplicated by physical locator; wire [raw source TR, start column, rowspan, colspan, literal]
wire.units: [expanded row, column, value pool index, row-axis pool indices, prefix pool indices]; raw and expanded coordinate systems explicitly distinguished
wire.receipt: full physical locators, source maps, stored payload witnesses, validation rejections, pool locator mapping and every budget decision

selection_and_budget: projector receives no query, case ID, answer key or target value
original delivered source order then physical expanded row and column order
first frame and first unit including all dependencies must fit atomically
subsequent unit and newly referenced physical cells must fit atomically
oversized unit skipped with full pool rollback; continue later units in fixed order
no context shortening, source refill, reordering or outcome-guided retry
no standalone frame without an admitted numeric unit

evaluation.supplement: evaluation_supplement.json frozen before seeing FCT12 output
panels: legacy26 required units grouped as common20 and HOLD6
T12 gains retained or lost separately from A12 preservation

decision.positive_signal: At least one currently missing required numeric fact actually delivered with required axes and no observed wrong linkage or required-evidence regression
decision.not_sufficient: More source-validated cells, increased bytes or restored captions alone do not establish numeric/answer improvement
decision.stop: No further variant or runtime adoption if target facts remain excluded, wrong bindings appear, or source contracts need weakening

disclosure: Development-exposed 77 questions and repeated diagnostic reuse; source author review is not blind. Mechanical preservation cannot prove model comprehension or answer accuracy. Reviewer factual audits and synthetic contracts are local/offline only.
preservation: Write only this new ignored experiment directory; hash all 5393 prior protected files and verify .env, all active v12 store files, git HEAD/index/status unchanged. No commits or current-status documentation edits.
